hints.text: This clue is an &lit clue, which means that the whole clue is the definition (and the wordplay too). So, our definition is 'Fig 'n' ram', which in this clue, is an example of our answer. We'll need to find a category that might combine figs with rams.

This clue is a rebus clue where the wordplay instructions are in the answer and their effect is in the clue. So, our answer will describe some letter manipulation (as well as supplying the letters to manipulate) that gets us 'Fig 'n' ram'. This makes sense for two reasons: our clue looks like it's providing letters to manipulate (especially with 'n') and our answer is longer than the clue itself (and the effect of letterplay is almost always shorter than the instructions).

The technique present in the answer is an anagram technique. Our answer tells us to anagram a seven letter word, and that will give us the seven letters of our clue. And the answer will simultaneously represent 'Fig 'n' ram' as the definition!
